name: ARA4503
title: Engine Protocol transport stopped
summary: The editor's localhost Engine Protocol server stopped accepting connections, so ara commands and MCP agents cannot reach this editor.
html:
The editor's localhost Engine Protocol server stopped accepting connections, so ara commands and MCP agents cannot reach this editor.

#Common causes

  • The port was taken or the listener failed.

#Fixes

  • Restart the editor; agents reconnect through the project's .ara/daemon.json.

  • Code: ARA4503

  • Constant: editor::TRANSPORT

  • Reported by: ara-editor
